# Bacterial Genomes

Bacterial simulations are commonly haploid and may include circular chromosomes, plasmids, operons, rRNA operons, CRISPR arrays, mobile elements, and strong local repeat effects. Use a real reference or explicitly label a genome as synthetic. For assembly benchmarks, circularity, plasmid copy depth, repeat length, and long-read length are central design variables.

Do not transfer diploid GWAS coding or eukaryotic enhancer assumptions without an explicit biological reason.
